headline: Proposed changes to how the police and fire chiefs are chosen, and a new police chief appointment.
summary: Scott A. Carola is up for appointment as Chief of Police, with a term ending 11/29/2029. Four councilors sponsored both ordinance changes.
items: Appointment of Scott A. Carola as Chief of Police, term ending 11/29/2029
Amend ordinance on selection of police chief and manner of appointment (GCO Ch. 17, Sec. 17-18)
Amend ordinance on screening of fire chief and manner of appointment (GCO Ch. 8, Sec. 8-18)
location: 1st Floor Council Conference Room, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
